entry.title: New: Resolution 124 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR MULTI-YEAR LEASES FOR SEVEN MULTI-FUNCTION COPY MACHINES FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into five-year lease agreements with an approximate monthly cost of $59 each for six copiers and $179 for one copier, to be used by the department’s Highway Maintenance Division at Hawai‘i County base yards.
